name: Google Workspace
description: Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail, and Calendar tools using your own Google account — runs locally with your OAuth credentials.
author: Maestro Press

env_vars.name: GOOGLE_CREDENTIALS_FILE
env_vars.description: Path to your Google OAuth client JSON (default: ~/.config/google-workspace-mcp/credentials.json)

env_vars.name: GOOGLE_TOKEN_FILE
env_vars.description: Path to your saved OAuth token (default: ~/.config/google-workspace-mcp/token.json)

notes: Python MCP server run via uvx from github.com/kh0pper/google-workspace-mcp (57 tools across Drive, Docs, Sheets, Slides, Gmail, Calendar). One-time setup: create a Google Cloud OAuth client (Desktop type), save its JSON to ~/.config/google-workspace-mcp/credentials.json, then run `uvx --from git+https://github.com/kh0pper/google-workspace-mcp google-workspace-mcp-authorize --manual` and follow the prompts. Full guide: https://github.com/kh0pper/google-workspace-mcp
